chunks: Ahmad ibn Harun al-Fami (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far narrated to us from his father, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid al-Anbari. He said: Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal narrated to us from Isma'il ibn al-Fadl al-Hashimi, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father Muhammad ibn 'Ali, from his father 'Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father al-Husayn ibn 'Ali, from his father Amir al-Mu'minin 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them).

He said: I said to the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him and his family): Inform me of the number of the Imams after you. So he said: O 'Ali! They are twelve. You are the first of them, and al-Qa'im is the last of them.

key_terms.أمير المؤمنين: Amir al-Mu'minin — Commander of the Faithful, the highest honorific of Imam Ali
key_terms.اثنا عشر: Twelve — the precise number affirming the Twelver doctrine of the imamate
key_terms.الأئمة: The Imams — the twelve divinely-appointed successors of the Prophet in Shia theology
key_terms.القائم: Al-Qa'im — 'the one who rises/stands up', a title for the twelfth Imam, the Mahdi, who is in occultation and will return to establish justice

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say to Imam Ali about the number of Imams after him?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a direct conversation between Imam Ali (AS) and the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) in which the Prophet explicitly declares the number of Imams after him to be twelve, naming Ali as the first and al-Qa'im (the Imam who will rise at the end of times) as the last. This narration is significant in Shia theology as it establishes the doctrine of the Twelve Imams through a chain going through four consecutive Imams (al-Sadiq, al-Baqir, Zayn al-'Abidin, al-Husayn) back to Imam Ali himself. The assembly context (Sha'ban 368 AH) places this transmission during the minor occultation period, lending urgency to the identification of the awaited Qa'im.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Harun al-Fami (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abdullah b. Ja`far narrated to us from his father from Ya`qub b. Yazid al-Anbari. He said: Al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Faddal narrated to us from Isma`il b. al-Fadl al-Hashimi from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father Muhammad b. `Ali from his father `Ali b. al-Husayn from his father a-Husayn b. `Ali from his father Amir al-Mu’minin `Ali b. Abi Talib (as).
He said: I said to the Messenger of Allah (s): Inform me of the number of Imams after you. So, he said: O `Ali! They are twelve. You are the first of them, and the Qa’im is the last of them.
